text:
Mia Chen: quick async — scheduling a dry-run traffic slice tonight 23:00 UTC (slice id: slice-42). What I did: finished router change for slicing, validated k8s manifests, ran local smoke. Blockers: embeddings integration tests failing intermittently. Today: coordinate the dry-run, confirm FF path and smoke endpoints, and have rollback ready. @Samir can you own monitoring during the window? :eyes:

Samir Patel: yep I can watch. will wire up dashboards and an alert for p50/p95 latency and 5xx spike. linked the temp dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/slice-42. Also set up a Prometheus rule: increase alert sensitivity at 2x baseline.

Julian Torres: embedding tests are failing because of a recent model config change — small mismatch in tokenizer config. PR with fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/312. I can patch and request quick review; might be done before the dry-run but flagging risk.

Kevin Wu: reminder: turn off aggressive prewarming for the slice to avoid false-positive scaling. quick command to patch HPA: `kubectl patch hpa inference-hpa -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":1}}'` — revert after window. Also keep the rollback command handy: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference --to-revision=3`

Anna Li: I'll run the smoke checklist and post results in this thread. smoke endpoints: `/v1/health`, `/v1/smoke/generate`, `/v1/embeddings/status`. Run bandwidth test too.

Mia Chen: runbook here: https://runbook.internal/redwood/traffic-slices/dry-run. Steps 1-4 are prep, step 5 is toggle FF to 10% for slice-42, smoke, then increase if green. Use feature flag endpoint: `curl -X POST https://flags.internal/ff_traffic_slices?slice=slice-42&percent=10 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'`

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created (#MT-5983) for tonight's window, allocated on-call: Samir Patel.

Samir Patel: noted. I'll post status at start, 10m, 30m, and end. If p50 > 300ms or 5xx rate > 0.5% I'll trigger rollback.

Julian Torres: if I can't get the embedding fix merged in time, suggestion: add a temporary route rule to exclude embeddings calls from slice-42. small NGINX annotation change, low risk.

Mia Chen: good idea. if anyone sees anything odd ping me directly. I'll log the toggle actions in the runbook as we go. :thumbsup:
